# Grounding
Gitboard serves as a local coordination layer for developer-centric code changes, bridging the gap between remote forge states (GitHub/GitLab) and local worktree environments. It provides a unified view of CI status, pull/merge request lifecycles, and job triage to accelerate local development velocity.
## Objectives
The system operates on the following core objectives:
Synchronize Forge State: Maintain a real-time local representation of remote repository activity using `gh` and `glab`.
Triage Visibility: Surface failed CI jobs and open MRs directly to the local developer interface.
Worktree Alignment: Map remote change requests to local checkout and worktree states to facilitate seamless context switching.
## Typology & Roles
The product's functional landscape is defined by the integration of local CLI tooling and remote forge APIs:
Forge Integrators: Interfaces for `gh` and `glab` that pull remote metadata.
State Monitors: Logic for tracking CI/CD status and job failures.
Local Context Providers: Mechanisms for inspecting and managing local `git` worktrees and checkout states.
